purpose: Prove actual isolated genesis and complete fixed scientific replay of the nine remaining v3 stages, then issue a full v3 parent receipt only if all eleven stage transactions pass
original_commands: Use only clean_parent_producers.stage_commands with cwd=isolated run root, source scripts from the pinned published checkout and canonical isolated data/cache/weather/parent paths. No original downloader or source-root artifact use.

genesis_and_replay.prelaunch: Hash source closure, independently acquired raw/weather manifest and every prior actual stage transaction/output byte. Reverify two baseline source/model/OOF transactions before the first downstream child. Require 10 GiB free physical RAM and exclusive fresh stage/transaction paths before running.
genesis_and_replay.actual_run: Run the allowlisted original CLI once with fixed arguments into a fresh stage. Rehash source, raw/weather and all prior outputs after each command. No resume after partial failure.
genesis_and_replay.independent_replay: Independently reconstruct saved model predictions and fixed source formulas from SHA-sealed inputs. Compare exact ordered IDs, labels, folds, covariate schemas and prediction values with the stage outputs; recompute reported scoring/selection fields. Do not use a claim written by the child as sole evidence. Every actual output byte is then SHA-bound in the transaction.
genesis_and_replay.saved_models: For every .txt LightGBM model produced by missing, weather, airports and LOBT, load the actual saved model, require source-consistent schema/objective/rounds and replay its heldout OOF and ranking predictions through original pure feature/proxy functions. Training, early and heldout ordered ID/label SHA are captured where each stage exposes them.
genesis_and_replay.deterministic_stages: Grouped, schedule tail, ensemble and LOBT blend use source-pure table/statistics/formula recomputation with exact ID and value comparison. LIRF saves no model files, so one separate fixed-source refit in a fresh replay directory is required; compare its OOF/ranking/report scientific values, allowing only explicitly named output-path fields to differ.
genesis_and_replay.promotion: Promote only independently verified files exclusively to the canonical isolated stage directory; read back output hashes and write a single actual transaction. A stage with an orphaned partial file refuses.

full_v3_receipt: No real remaining-v3 stage or full receipt is currently authorized. The corrected prospective parent contract truthfully records original heldout-label early stopping and policy selection. Once the exact reviewed adapter SHA is published, eleven actual-genesis stage transactions can be proved and the complete receipt emitted without a fabricated fit-and-early exclusion assertion.

review_authorization.current_state: The corrected parent spec pins the exact independently reviewed remaining.py file SHA; every real stage and emit-v3 additionally require matching Git HEAD source/spec bytes and independently sealed isolated inputs before any value read
review_authorization.review_pin_scope: The reviewed pin authenticates only SHA256(replica_v3_remaining.py file), never the adapter spec hash or a source-snapshot aggregate; the adapter source bytes contain no parent-spec or remaining-spec literal hash
acyclic_publication_order: Independently review and publish the corrected legacy erratum and parent, timestamp and baseline proof source/spec bytes
Independently review and publish this remaining-stage adapter source file at a fixed SHA
Publish the parent reviewed_v3_proof_adapter_sha256 equal to that fixed file SHA and revise its prospective synthetic test to verify the enabled exact pin
Repin the resulting parent source/spec SHA in the baseline proof spec, then repin the baseline spec and parent source/spec SHAs in this remaining-stage spec

Publish all final source/spec bytes; before each real stage require exact Git HEAD file bytes, isolated-root source/raw seals and proved prior-stage genesis; emit the full receipt only after all eleven stage proofs and the reviewed adapter pin
review_authorization.cycle_check: Parent spec pin to remaining.py file SHA does not depend on parent or remaining spec bytes; parent spec changes propagate only forward to baseline spec and remaining spec. Runtime source snapshots hash these final spec bytes after publication.
review_authorization.failure_policy: Any null/mismatched reviewed pin, unpublished or changed Git HEAD bytes, stale transitive spec SHA or missing actual-genesis prior-stage transaction refuses; no generic caller-supplied hash bypass

known_science_contract_blocker.original_baseline_source: solution.train: early_idx = core_labeled & valid_month; model fit excludes heldout, early stopping uses heldout
known_science_contract_blocker.corrected_parent_requirement: clean_parent_producers.verify_external_v3 and replica_v4_timestamp.validate_manifest_metadata now require the exact pinned legacy erratum fields: fit_excludes_heldout=true, early_stop_uses_heldout=true, fit_and_early_exclude_heldout=false, and a full per-stage policy map
known_science_contract_blocker.consequence: emit-v3 still refuses before any value read or receipt write until the corrected parent contract and this adapter are independently reviewed and published

resource_and_validation_limits: LIRF's unsaved models require an extra small fixed-source fit. Saved-model stages use their actual model files for replay and do not require a second full training pass. The 2025 validation months are repeatedly inspected and do not represent untouched evaluation.
